text: Paál placed a cut tip off-centre, in darkness, and got bending anyway: the chemical, not the light, makes the curve. Finally Went, in nineteen twenty-eight, soaked the chemical out of tips into agar blocks. A block on one side of a decapitated oat coleoptile made it bend away from that side. He named the substance auxin.
